known.title: [P2] Preserve the statistics summary in plain forge next output

findings.body: Plain `forge next` now always passes a history dictionary to `_report`, but `_report` still emits the statistics summary only when `history is None` (nextstep.py:327–328). Consequently, from the configured check date, 2026-11-15, ordinary text output permanently loses the cycle-time, human-touch and Forge-fix metrics. Existing assertions in tests/test_board.py:181 and tests/test_fix_one_worktree_with_settings_the_installed.py:52 require that summary. Keep snapshot reuse separate from the decision to show text-only statistics.
findings.title: [P2] Preserve the statistics summary in plain forge next output

why: The pane's refresh runs forge next and forge lanes, and next also runs the same slow board build, so the first load waits on it; the pane already shows Couldn't refresh when a first load fails, so only the speed part is new.
